reviewContinuity.scope: Actual runner diff and its coverage, failure propagation, reuse and publication consumers.

evidenceInspected: AGENTS.md, reviewer persona, REVIEW_PROTOCOL.md, active D3 acceptance, relevant product/platform requirements and Technical Decisions §6–6.1. Node v24.21.0.
Startup checks: committed HEAD has no push CI run; D3 remains IN_PROGRESS; D3-PHONE-UPDATE remains NEEDS_SETUP. Dirty edits are outside committed-HEAD CI coverage.
.github/workflows/ci.yml adds ubuntu-latest and macos-15 with fail-fast false. Neither job uses continue-on-error. Both job failures contribute to the workflow result.
macOS runs unchanged npm run verify:all, including verification, full-week, offline, regular and test update journeys, test isolation and all three configured Playwright projects.

Linux retains verification, full-week, offline and every spec belonging to both existing Chromium projects. The runner forwards both --project arguments unchanged. Full-week is a domain script; the offline check uses Chromium, matching Linux's browser installation.

playwright.config.ts and package.json are unchanged: no project membership, assertion, timing bound, timeout or retry count changes. Application, persistence, SDK and production worker lifecycle files are unchanged.
Matrix artifact names include the operating system, preventing collisions. Flaky results remain uploaded through always(); failure traces and reports retain their existing failure condition.

scripts/ci-scope.mjs treats the changed workflow file as browser-impacting. Missing, failed or unknown predecessor verification runs browser checks. Documentation-only inheritance remains conditional on a successful previous workflow.

scripts/ci-status.mjs exact-commit reuse requires a completed successful push run of ci.yml, excludes the current run and does not reuse manual dispatches or reruns. It evaluates the whole workflow, without selecting one successful matrix job.

scripts/milestone.mjs and scripts/deploy-test-site.mjs still require whole-workflow success for the exact checkpoint. The test publisher additionally retains recorded clean-source verification, mandatory checks and review evidence.

.github/workflows/deploy-pages.yml remains unchanged: automatic publication waits for successful push workflow completion on main and checks out that workflow's exact SHA. The runner diff does not introduce an automatic publication bypass.
Technical Decisions, implementation plan and local-development guide describe runner responsibilities, require both jobs, preserve observed failures and leave exact CI and publication pending.

.evidence/D3/ci-adapter-initialization.json preserves immutable D2 Linux reopen failure at 9047 ms and D3 Linux reopen failure at 11062 ms. It also preserves D3 macOS first-open failure at 5494 ms against the unchanged 5000 ms bound. All comparisons retain identical 609 rows, 40 students and 520 evaluations.

Earlier RH2-1, RH-2 and RH2-3 resolutions remain supported by retained reports. R7 portal geometry, persistence proof and RH4-Q1 resolution were not altered or rerun. Field residual FU-Q13 remains separately recorded.
Root reported verify:quick passing 80 files and 1351 tests, with lint, formatting, typecheck, check:docs and check:repository passing.
This reviewer made no tracked edits or commits and ran no browser or test suite.

lenses: Coverage and failure propagation through the CI matrix
Exact-checkpoint reuse and documentation-only scope inheritance
Milestone and publication gates consuming the workflow result
anglesTried.wildcard: Restricted follow-up only; no new whole-milestone hunt.

notTested: The reviewed working diff is uncommitted and has not passed exact-checkpoint CI. This verdict does not establish D3 readiness.

Runner selection is not a production performance fix. Linux compilation failures and the macOS 5494 ms first-open failure remain unresolved observations; macOS timing acceptance still needs the required run.
Any retry-only success must remain classified and recorded under the existing flaky-test policy.
Final recorder verification, verified GitHub test publication and physical Android installation/update acceptance remain pending. No physical-device PASS is inferred.
GitHub repository branch-protection configuration was not inspected; repository gates inspected here consume the complete workflow conclusion.
